title: Team deployment
description: Deploy a shared service with Docker Compose, HTTPS and access controls.
text: Team deployment centralizes model configuration, records and the workbench on a server. Members use a browser. This guide covers startup, access, HTTPS and maintenance. Start the service Prepare Docker and Compose v2.24+, clone and configure .env using installation, then run: docker compose up -d --build docker compose ps docker compose logs -f app The default port is 8767. Members use http://server-IP:8767; configure mappings with LLM4OM_PORT. Service components Workflow overviewDownload SVG app creates Workers through the host Docker socket. Workers use disabled networking, read-only root filesystems, non-root execution and resource limits, then are removed. llm4om-data retains presets, history and runs. Shared access The workbench uses a shared workspace: members use presets, view runs and manage notes and records. Configure team IP access or an authenticated reverse proxy at the service entrance. The Docker socket grants app permission to create host containers; choose and configure the host accordingly. See configuration for defaults, quotas and concurrency. Domain and HTTPS Point a domain at the server and open ports 80/443. Set the actual domain in .env: LLM4OM_DOMAIN=llm4om.example.edu LLM4OM_PORT=127.0.0.1:8767 LLM4OM_TRUST_PROXY=1 Then run: docker compose --profile https up -d --build docker compose logs -f https Caddy obtains and stores certificates and forwards pages and live streams to app. LLM4OM_TRUST_PROXY=1 counts hourly usage by forwarded client address. Concurrency and resources Set active runs in compose.override.yaml, for example: services: app: command: ["llm4om", "serve", "--workspace", "/data", "--port", "8767", "--jobs", "8"] LLM4OM_SANDBOX_JOBS separately controls all concurrent solves and checking scripts. Choose values according to model-service quotas and host resources. Update, migrate and back up Run git pull, then docker compose up -d --build for updates. Apply environment changes with docker compose up -d app. docker compose down stops services while retaining data volumes. To migrate a Python workspace, stop the target app, copy inputs into /data/, then start. See backups for commands and backends for license mounts.

title: Configuration, usage and backups
description: Configure LLMs, concurrency, usage limits and persistent storage.
text: Configuration controls default models, concurrency, quotas and persistence. Compose uses .env and a data volume; Python services use environment variables and --workspace. Model and search settings Field Role LLM4OM_LLM_PROVIDER Default provider LLM4OM_LLM_BASE_URL Service endpoint LLM4OM_LLM_MODEL Actual model ID LLM4OM_LLM_API_KEY Service credentials LLM4OM_LLM_NAME Display name LLM4OM_LLM_EXTRA_BODY Provider-specific JSON LLM4OM_SEARCH_API_KEY Separate search credentials LLM4OM_SEARCH_BASE_URL Search endpoint DeepSeek presets can use their own search configuration; other providers use separate search credentials. See presets. Shared usage limits LLM4OM_DAILY_TOKENS=2000000 LLM4OM_RUNS_PER_HOUR=30 LLM4OM_SANDBOX_JOBS=4 TZ=Asia/Shanghai LLM4OM_TRUST_PROXY=1 Daily quotas count input plus output tokens per preset. Hourly limits count runs per client address. Zero or unset limits are unlimited. TZ=Asia/Shanghai resets daily usage at Beijing midnight. The preset dialog shows usage. At the daily cap, the next model call shows a quota message; choose another available preset or continue the following day. Saved results remain readable. Two concurrency levels Workflow overviewDownload SVG serve --jobs defaults to four active runs, with others queued. Four sandbox slots cover all solves and checks, including parallel AutoFormulation checks. Waiting counts toward run limits. One service process manages each workspace. Back up the workspace The volume stores presets, credentials, history and runs. Stop app to finish persistence, then copy: docker compose stop app docker compose cp app:/data ./llm4om-backup chmod -R go-rwx ./llm4om-backup docker compose start app Keep backups in access-controlled storage. For Python services, back up the selected --workspace directory. Restore or migrate docker compose stop app docker compose cp ./llm4om-backup/. app:/data/ docker compose start app To migrate Python history, substitute runs/web/. or the actual workspace. After startup, inspect presets and a historical run to confirm records and attachments. The service persists every ten seconds and at normal exit, writing a temporary file before renaming. Normal stop commands complete persistence of public steps and artifacts. Optional call tracing Set LANGSMITH_TRACING, LANGSMITH_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_PROJECT for external tracing. Enabled tracing sends problems, data and model replies to LangSmith while retaining local run records. See the repository's environment example and team deployment for HTTPS and service access.

title: CLI and Python
description: Run the same modeling workflows from the CLI or Python.
text: CLI and Python execute the same modeling graphs as the workbench. Use them for batches, saved states and integration. Prepare dependencies and Worker using installation, then select an LLM preset. Run one problem from the CLI Save the quickstart production statement as UTF-8 problem.txt. Use a preset in the workspace: uv run llm4om run --file problem.txt --workspace runs/web --method direct --language pyomo --solver highs --output result.json The terminal shows stages, formulation, code and result. result.json retains final state and steps for further processing. Attach data and select a preset uv run llm4om run --file problem.txt --data production.json --method bind --language pyomo --workspace runs/web --preset your-preset-id --output result.json Repeat --data for more files. Code reads text by original file name. --preset uses a saved workspace ID; omission selects the default. Download data from attachments. Option Purpose --problem / --file Inline statement or UTF-8 file --method ID such as feedback_repair or sac_opt --language ID such as pyomo, ortools or cvxpy --solver Native ID; omission uses AUTO --workspace / --preset Preset workspace and ID --output Save final JSON state Complete minimal Python call from llm4om import run_problem state = run_problem( "Produce nonnegative integer A and B with profits 3 and 2. " "Cutting: 2A+B<=8; finishing: A+2B<=8. Maximize total profit.", method="direct", language="pyomo", solver="highs", workspace="runs/web", explain=True, locale="en", ) print(state.get("failure") or state.get("solve")) The returned state includes problem, configuration, formulation, code, solve and steps. explain=True adds a business explanation; locale sets its language. Supply complete data in Python from pathlib import Path from llm4om import run_problem state = run_problem( "Use production.json to choose nonnegative integer quantities and maximize profit. " "usage is resource-by-product hours per unit; capacity is available hours.", method="bind", language="pyomo", data={"production.json": Path("production.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")}, workspace="runs/web", ) print(state.get("solve", {}).get("variables")) data maps file names to text, matching workbench attachments. Supply model configuration explicitly Pass llm=LLMSettings(...) for script-defined service configuration and read credentials from environment variables. Fields are defined in LLMSettings. Method parameters come from presets. Async integrations can use lower-level run and Resources; see the public Python module. Handle run state Read failure and solve.status before processing values. Steps locate model calls, execution and validation feedback. For browsable retained history, the workbench provides links, tags, notes and exports; see history.

title: Troubleshooting
description: Resolve connection, LLM, solver and result issues from the actual error.
text: Start with the failed stage and complete error. The following checks cover connections, model requests, execution, validation and recovery. Pages and service connections Symptom Check/action Local page unavailable Inspect docker compose ps and docker compose logs -f app Other devices cannot connect Check server IP, mapping, firewall and security group HTTPS certificate issue Check DNS, ports 80/443 and docker compose logs -f https Interrupted live progress Refresh the run link; inspect proxy streaming and server logs Python startup prints the listening address and workspace. Compose uses LLM4OM_PORT. Presets and model requests Error Action 401 Check key and provider 404 Check endpoint, protocol and model ID Structured-output/tool-choice error Inspect service tool support, method and advanced parameters DeepSeek with TriVAL Set {"thinking":{"type":"disabled"}} in the run preset Quota message Check daily usage and select an available preset or continue next day Failed saves retain entered values. Follow preset configuration, then confirm with a small example. Execution environment and code For a missing Worker, run docker compose up -d --build, or uv run llm4om build-worker in Python setups. For Docker connection errors, inspect the service, socket permissions and DOCKER_SOCKET. For backend/license failures, read complete feedback and follow backend setup. Execution errors identify exceptions and stages. Locate file names, fields, indices, return objects or APIs, then rerun the appropriate repair workflow from the problem. Method validation and solver results TriVAL retains semantic, formulation and code validation; SAC-Opt retains per-constraint comparisons; Feedback Repair retains accept/repair reasons. Failure messages identify stages, with artifacts and executions in the process view. Open the relevant stage and compare feedback with its model/code version. Method articles provide stopping conditions, return paths and parameters for following the run. Infeasibility and native statuses Use conflict analysis when IIS/MUS evidence is available, then revise the relevant rules. For nonlinear paths, inspect starts, bounds and native feedback before computing further scenarios. Run information records time, calls and quotas. See configuration for limits and solvers for mathematical selection. Recovery and issue records Refresh reconnects conversations to active runs; open saved plans from cards or history. Retry original messages after stopping. Batch retries reuse saved scenarios and continue remaining work. Capture run link, method, library, backend, public preset configuration, failed stage, complete error and relevant problem text. These connect an issue to concrete inputs and execution. See maintenance for logs and backups.
